_route.brief: The race for the earliest signing: on challenge the deed is out of reach for cash, so the race is to the loan shark's offer. Every spare credit is saved from day 1 (no insurance ever, Wild's upgrades for favor only), the shop sells down so Georgio borrows the most on day 43, and his fourfold payback on day 69 makes the 15,000 the offer needs. Signed on day 70, the deed comes sixteen payments later, around day 182.
